hypothesis: Wave 2 still asks one model operation to choose which proposition in a retrieved region matters and to normalize that proposition. Deterministically enumerating exact proposition spans, forcing Qwen to select at most one known proposition ID, and only then asking a separate normalization call to convert that exact span into one atomic claim will improve source-proposal alignment and/or normalized teacher agreement without reopening guard collateral or changing retrieval.

fixed: tensor_parallel_size=2 on the accepted two RTX A4500 devices
FACET_INTERLEAVED_BM25_V1 ranking algorithm and facet queries
one accepted claim maximum per selected region
twelve accepted claims maximum per paper
preserved teacher_agreement lexical scorer and F1>=0.5 pass threshold
changed: Within each selected region, deterministic code enumerates exact terminal proposition spans and assigns immutable proposition IDs with exact PDF page/start/end offsets.
Qwen proposal stage sees proposition IDs/text for exactly one retrieved region and may select at most one known proposition ID or SKIP; it cannot emit normalized claims or source text.
Only a guard-validated selected proposition is passed to a separate Qwen normalization call, which may emit one atomic claim or SKIP.
Accepted raw_source_form/page/offset provenance is copied deterministically from the selected exact proposition, never from model-generated text.

exact_proposition_contract.boundary_rule: terminal punctuation [.!?] optionally followed by closing quote/paren/bracket and followed by whitespace/end, with a bounded abbreviation guard for common scientific abbreviations
exact_proposition_contract.incomplete_trailing_text: not proposal-eligible unless it ends at an accepted terminal boundary
exact_proposition_contract.provenance: raw_source_form is the exact authoritative PDF substring and start/end offsets are absolute page-text coordinates

safety: unknown proposition IDs hard-reject only that region unit
model cannot provide or modify source text
zero complete propositions yields deterministic SKIP with no proposal model call
hard normalization faults remain unit-local residuals

interpretation: If selected-proposition source alignment improves and normalized agreement also improves, retain proposal/normalization separation and next test bounded multiple proposals only if needed.
If proposal alignment improves but normalized agreement does not, normalization semantics or the legacy teacher granularity/scorer is the next residual.
If proposal alignment does not improve, do not add normalization complexity; revisit candidate proposal/reranking or a specialized IE component.
Do not change the preserved teacher F1 threshold after seeing the result.

teacher_control_limitation: The legacy six-claim normalized teacher subset covers only one paper and several teacher claims contain multiple facts while the local output contract is atomic. Wave 4 therefore preserves that scorer unchanged as a continuity gate and adds proposal-stage source-alignment diagnostics; it does not weaken or replace the teacher threshold.
